repo.description:
### Impact

The user in a group can bypass the group restriction set by an administrator on link sharing, creating share links for a table even though they shouldn't have that permission.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Tables is upgraded to 0.9.10, 1.0.7 or 2.1.0 or 1.0.7

### Workarounds

* Disable app Tables

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3642236)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/tables/pull/2551)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/tables/pull/2556)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Tables application does not respect sharing limitations set by admin
